name: Professional Portfolio
summary: A bilingual professional portfolio that presents my projects, experience, technology stack, education, and contact channels in one responsive experience.
functions: Organizes projects by category, presents detailed case studies, translates the content, and offers an AI assistant for exploring my professional profile.
problem: I needed a clear and accessible place to centralize my experience, technical profile, and growing collection of software projects.
solution: I developed a responsive portfolio with section navigation, interactive project cases, bilingual content, and direct access to my professional profiles.
